description_en: Retrieves pricing information for simple application server products
description_zh: 获取轻量产品价格信息
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open create-order --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --commodity AutoRenewPeriod=1 PlanId=swas.s.c2m1s30b1.linux Amount=1 AutoRenew=false ImageId=3e8eea0c00a04ff0b34a3ad8f1df455a Period=1 PayType=Prepaid DataDiskSize=0 AutoPay=false InstanceIds=["example-string"] CommodityType=Server PeriodUnit=Month --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateOrder

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html to query available regions
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查询可用地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The order type. Valid values:

Buy

Default value: Buy
parameters.help_zh:
订单类型：

Buy

默认值：Buy
parameters.name: order_type

fields.help_en:
The number of simple application servers to create. Valid values: 1 to 20.

Default value: 1
fields.help_zh:
创建轻量应用服务器的数量。取值范围：1~20

默认值：1
fields.name: amount

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment for the order. Valid values:

true: Automatic payment is enabled.
false: Automatic payment is not enabled
fields.help_zh:
订单是否自动支付。取值：

true：自动支付。
false：不自动支付
fields.name: auto_pay

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal upon expiration. Valid values:

true: Enable auto-renewal.
false: Disable auto-renewal.

Default value: false
fields.help_zh:
是否开启到期自动续费。取值范围：

true：开启
false：不开启

默认值：false
fields.name: auto_renew

fields.help_en:
The auto-renewal period. Valid values:

When PeriodUnit is set to Year: 1, 2, or 3.
When PeriodUnit is set to Month: 1, 2, 3, 6, 12, 24, 36, 48, or 60.

Default value: 1
fields.help_zh:
单次自动续费的续费时长。取值范围：

PeriodUnit=Year 时：1、2、3。
PeriodUnit=Month 时：1、2、3、6、12、24、36、48、60。

默认值：1
fields.name: auto_renew_period

fields.help_en: The resource name
fields.help_zh: 资源名称
fields.name: commodity_type

fields.help_en:
The capacity of the attached data cloud disk. Unit: GB. Valid values: 0 to 16380. The value must be a multiple of 20.

Default value: 0
fields.help_zh:
挂载的数据盘容量大小。单位：GB。取值范围：0~16380，取值必须是20的整数倍。

默认值：0
fields.name: data_disk_size

fields.help_en: The image ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189313.html to query available image IDs in a specified region
fields.help_zh: 镜像ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189313.html查询指定地域下可用的镜像ID

fields.help_en:

Prepaid: subscription

Prepaid：预付费（包年包月）

fields.help_en:
The subscription duration for querying the price of purchasing a plan in bulk. Valid values: 1 to 20.
Default value: 1
fields.help_zh:
查询批量购买某种套餐的价格。取值范围：1~20。

fields.name: period

fields.help_en:
Valid values:

Month: the billing unit for monthly subscription.
Year: the billing unit for yearly subscription.

Default value: Month

Month：按月计费的价格单位。
Year：按年计费的价格单位。

默认值：Month
